'''Orrin Loneozner''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] unemployed [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Rogues Gallery">{{InsiderCite|131|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: An Audience of Aliens}}</ref> They watched the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] from [[Watto/Legends|Watto's]] box<ref name="Episode I">{{Film|I}}</ref> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> standing almost directly behind Watto.<ref name="Episode I" />

Loneozner shared a surname with [[Laze Loneozner/Legends|Laze "Fixer" Loneozner]],<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref> a fellow Human from Tatooine who was a friend of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="Episode IV novel">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novel]]</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Wattos_box.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Orinn (behind Watto) watches the Boonta Eve Classic]]
Orrin Loneozner first appeared in the [[1999]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="Episode I" /> He was first identified in the [[2012]] [[Star Wars Insider 131|''Star Wars Insider'' 131]] article "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery: An Audience of Aliens]]."<ref name="Rogues Gallery" />
